title: On-page SEO team leader
description:
About us

Black Swan Media Co is a US-based AI automation and SEO agency. We work with local service businesses — HVAC, plumbing, auto body — and help them rank and generate leads using proven on-page systems. We run lean, move fast, and hold high standards. This is not a generic content mill role.



What this role actually is

We're looking for a sharp, experienced SEO professional to lead our on-page team. You won't just execute - you'll own quality, train the team, and be the final set of eyes before anything goes live. You'll work directly with the agency owner and have real influence over how we do things.



This is a leadership role first, SEO role second. If you've never managed other VAs or reviewed someone else's work before publishing, this is not the right fit yet.



Your responsibilities

Lead and supervise a small team of on-page SEO specialists

Review and approve all on-page deliverables before they go to clients

Develop and maintain SOPs for meta titles, H-tag structures, schema markup, and internal linking

Perform technical on-page audits and deliver clear, actionable findings

Write optimized meta titles and descriptions that actually get clicks

Implement and validate schema markup (LocalBusiness, FAQ, Service types)

Conduct keyword research and map terms to page intent correctly

Communicate clearly with the agency owner via async updates (Loom + Slack)

Flag problems before they become client issues

Work hours are M-F 5 am EST - 12 pm EST



What you need to have

3+ years of hands-on on-page SEO experience (not just theory)

Proven experience leading or reviewing other SEO team members' work

Strong working knowledge of Google Search Console, Claude/ChatGPT for AI content, understand entities + entity density, and silo structures.

Solid understanding of schema markup and structured data - you can write it, not just install a plugin

Able to explain SEO decisions clearly in plain English

Reliable internet, available during agreed overlap hours with US Eastern Time

Comfortable using AI tools to assist work - but you know when AI is wrong

Experience with wordpress sites

Familiarity with local SEO ranking factors and GBP optimization



?? Read this before applying



We receive a high volume of applications. Most are ignored because they are clearly copy-pasted or AI-generated. We will know. To be considered, you must follow the application instructions below exactly. Applicants who do not follow the instructions will not receive a response - no exceptions.



How to apply

Send a message through OnlineJobs.ph. Your message must include all of the following:



Subject line: Start it with the word FALCON (this tells us you read the full post)

2–3 sentences on why you are qualified to lead a team, not just execute tasks

One specific example of an on-page change you made that improved rankings — include the type of page, what you changed, and approximately what happened to rankings

A short Loom video (2–3 minutes max) walking us through any live page you've optimized — explain your decisions out loud

No cover letter templates. No generic intros. If your first sentence is "I am writing to express my interest," stop and start over.

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Starbond



Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand specializing in high-quality adhesives and related products. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and other e-commerce and B2B channels.



We are building a more disciplined, data-driven Marketing function and are looking for a Marketing Director who can turn customer insight, strong execution, and sound unit economics into profitable, scalable growth.



About the Role



The Marketing Director will own the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Starbond’s Marketing function. This leader will establish the strategy, team structure, systems, decision rights, reporting, and cross-functional cadence required to drive profitable growth.



This is not a high-level advisory role. Starbond is still developing its marketing infrastructure, so the Marketing Director must be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You must be able to personally calculate, validate, and explain the numbers behind marketing performance—not rely solely on dashboards, agencies, or reports prepared by others.



You will oversee DTC growth across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion rate optimization, brand, and agency performance.



Key Responsibilities



Marketing Strategy and Leadership

Set annual and quarterly Marketing strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes.

Build a scalable Marketing operating model with clear workflows, decision rights, quality standards, and accountability.

Assess and improve the team’s structure, capabilities, tools, data, agencies, and cross-functional handoffs.

Develop capable leaders and owners beneath the role so execution does not depend on constant intervention.

Set team KPIs, coaching cadences, performance standards, succession plans, and corrective actions.

Provide the CEO with concise, financially grounded updates on results, risks, constraints, and recommended decisions.



Profitable DTC Growth

Own integrated DTC growth across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify,
, SEO, AEO, social media, content, CRO, and other relevant channels.

Establish acceptable acquisition thresholds by product, channel, campaign, customer segment, and cohort.

Determine when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue marketing investments.

Connect marketing plans with inventory, operational capacity, product readiness, and financial objectives.

Ensure marketing decisions prioritize profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone.



Marketing Analytics and Unit Economics

Personally calculate and validate CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MER, ROAS, gross margin, contribution margin, conversion rates, retention, cohort performance, and other funnel metrics.

Audit formulas, source data, assumptions, attribution methods, and agency reports for accuracy.

Identify incorrect calculations, inconsistent definitions, unsupported assumptions, and material data gaps.

Translate findings into specific decisions involving budgets, channels, campaigns, offers, creative, landing pages, retention, and resource allocation.

Ensure all material recommendations are financially grounded, traceable to source data, and ready for executive decision-making.



Agency and Channel Management

Manage agencies supporting paid media, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, content, creative, and related functions.

Define agency scopes, KPIs, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, ownership, and escalation paths.

Independently validate agency recommendations and hold partners accountable for results and deadlines.

Address underperformance promptly through documented corrective actions.

Ensure Starbond retains ownership and access to advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Brand, Customer Insight, and Execution

Own customer insight, positioning, messaging architecture, and brand standards.

Govern creative testing, content production, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, attribution, and conversion optimization.

Ensure campaigns and product launches have clear briefs, readiness checks, QA processes, measurement plans, and post-launch learning reviews.

Remain close enough to execution to inspect work, resolve critical blockers, and improve quality when needed.



Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a consistent planning cadence across Marketing, Product/R&D, Amazon, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Web Development, HR, and the CEO.

Anticipate inventory, capacity, staffing, technical, and operational constraints before they affect launches or marketing commitments.

Surface risks and difficult issues early, supported by evidence, tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation.

Challenge assumptions constructively and redirect resources when customer or financial evidence supports a different decision.



What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading a DTC or e-commerce Marketing function with accountability for profitable growth.

Strong hands-on knowledge of paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, CRO, content, SEO, and brand strategy.

Advanced understanding of unit economics, including CAC, LTV, CAC payback, MER, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, and cohort analysis.

Ability to independently recreate, audit, and explain marketing calculations using underlying source data.

Experience managing internal Marketing teams and developing accountable leaders.

Strong experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to defined KPIs, deadlines, and commercial expectations.

Ability to connect marketing performance with profitability, customer quality, retention, inventory, and operational capacity.

Experience building processes and systems within a growing or developing Marketing organization.

Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to clearly present evidence, financial impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

Willingness to challenge weak assumptions, confront underperformance, and make difficult decisions.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where strategy and hands-on execution are both required.



Tools and Platforms

Experience with several of the following is expected:

Shopify

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

 and lifecycle marketing platforms

Amazon reporting

Looker, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools

Google Workspace

ClickUp or similar project-management platforms

Agency reporting and attribution systems



What Success Looks Like

Marketing generates profitable DTC revenue and contribution-margin growth.

CAC and CAC payback remain within approved thresholds by channel, product, and cohort.

At least 90% of committed strategic milestones are delivered or formally replanned.

Agencies consistently meet deadlines and receive timely performance reviews and corrective actions.

Core unit-economics and funnel calculations are accurate, consistent, and traceable to source data.

The Marketing function has clear ownership, capable leaders, reliable reporting, and a scalable operating cadence.

Risks, performance misses, and resource constraints are communicated early with recommended actions.



This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You

Prefer to operate only as a strategist or advisor.

Depend entirely on analysts, agencies, or dashboards to explain marketing performance.

Present revenue or ROAS as proof of success without considering margin, retention, or customer quality.

Avoid challenging agencies, team members, or leadership when the evidence supports a different decision.

Are uncomfortable entering the details, auditing calculations, or personally unblocking critical work.

Require a fully developed marketing infrastructure before you can perform effectively.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Explain how you calculate CAC, LTV, CAC payback, and contribution margin. Include an example of how these metrics influenced a budget or channel decision.

Share an example of a marketing report, dashboard, or agency recommendation you found to be inaccurate. How did you validate the data, and what did you change?

Describe your experience building or restructuring a Marketing team or operating model.

Share an example of how you held an underperforming agency or team accountable.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, lifecycle marketing, and business intelligence platforms you have used.





We are looking for a Marketing Director who can build the function, develop strong owners, confront difficult issues, and stay close enough to the numbers and execution to drive measurable, profitable growth.

**Department:** Marketing & Content



## About Peakfinity Labs



Peakfinity Labs is a manufacturing company focused on supplements and cosmetics. We're looking for a talented Video Editor to help us tell our story — from the factory floor to the finished product — through compelling, high-quality video content.



## About the Role



We're hiring a Video Editor to create engaging video content that showcases our manufacturing processes, products, and company culture. You'll work with raw footage from our facilities and turn it into polished videos for marketing, training, social media, and internal communications.



## What You'll Do



- Edit raw footage into polished, engaging videos for marketing, social media, and internal use

- Cut manufacturing/process footage into clear, compelling narratives

- Add motion graphics, text overlays, color correction, and sound design as needed

- Collaborate with the marketing team on video concepts and messaging

- Manage multiple projects and turnaround deadlines

- Organize and maintain video assets and project files



## What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing video content (portfolio required — see below)

- Proficiency in editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Strong storytelling instincts — ability to turn raw, unscripted footage into a clear narrative

- Understanding of pacing, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics

- Comfortable working with industrial/manufacturing footage (a plus, not required)

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines



## How to Apply



To apply, please send us:



1. **Your portfolio** — a link or reel showcasing your best editing work.

2. **(Optional, but recommended) A sample edit** — To help us prioritize applications, we invite you to download raw footage from **
** and produce a short edited video (60–90 seconds) that tells a clear, engaging story using the clips provided. We want to see how you structure a narrative, pace cuts, and polish raw material — not just your software skills.



   *Tips for a strong sample edit:*

   - Choose a clear focus or theme rather than using every clip

   - Aim for a logical flow: an opening hook, a clear middle, and a satisfying close

   - Include basic color correction, clean audio, and simple titles/graphics if relevant

   - Keep it tight — quality of storytelling matters more than length



Applicants who submit a sample edit alongside their portfolio will be prioritized for review.

---



Peakfinity Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant / Operations Executor - U.S. Company (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
**About the Role**



We're a U.S.-based consulting firm and we're hiring a sharp, reliable operations VA to take repetitive work off the plates of the Founder and our most senior Partner. This is an internal operations role - you'll be the person who makes sure the routine machinery of the business runs without anyone having to think about it.



You will be given a lot of responsibility quickly. We use AI tools heavily, and a big part of what makes this role different is that you'll have AI systems and pre-built task guides to lean on - so you'll ramp faster and second-guess less than in a typical VA job. But you have to be the kind of person who takes real ownership and gets things done without being chased.



If you're a serial executor who's relentlessly online, obsessed with detail, and quick to learn new software, this is a role you can grow in for years.



Salary: $800/month to start (full-time), with room to grow for the right person

Hours: Full-time, Monday-Friday, must overlap U.S. Eastern hours (approx. 9:00am–7:00pm ET / 9:00pm–7:00am PHT)



**What you'll do**



- Run recurring daily tasks (payment reminders, confirmations, calendar management) using our existing AI-assisted systems

- Monitor account balances and keep internal trackers accurate and up to date

- Send templated
s to clients on our behalf (copy-paste from approved templates)

- Support the team when a client signs (document handling, sending standard
s and instructions)

- Prepare and distribute our weekly podcast materials to the team

- Handle YouTube upload details (titles, descriptions, metadata) with AI assistance, and send the corresponding
 blast

- Monthly reconciliation of advertising data into our tracker

- Basic bookkeeping entries (training provided)

- A wide variety of ad hoc tasks - whatever repetitive work needs doing



**Who we're looking for**



- A true jack of all trades - comfortable with many different software tools and, more importantly, able to learn new ones fast

- Obsessive attention to detail - this is the single most important trait. Small mistakes matter in this role

- Excellent written and spoken English - clear, professional, error-free

- Relentlessly responsive - you reply to
 and Slack in a minute or less during working hours. You're online and reachable

- High accountability and trustworthiness - you own your work, you don't need chasing, and you flag problems early

- Fast learner - you can be handed something new and figure it out, using AI and the guides we give you

- Hard worker - you're not afraid to work late, put in extra hours, or handle something on a weekend when it genuinely matters

- Comfortable with AI tools - or eager to become comfortable fast. We use them everywhere



**Nice to have (not required - we'll train)**



- Basic video editing skills (primarily pulling short clips from longer videos and basic long-form video editing)

- Familiarity with CRMs, Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheets

- Bookkeeping or QuickBooks experience

- Any experience supporting a U.S. company



**Why this role is different**



You won't be flying blind. We've built AI-assisted systems and task guides for most of what you'll do, so you'll have support at every step instead of guessing. You'll work directly with the Founder and our most senior Partner - no layers, no bureaucracy. And there's genuine long-term growth here for someone who proves they can be trusted with more.



**How to Apply**



To apply, do the following exactly:



1) Start your application with the word "EXECUTOR" at the very top so we know you read this carefully.

2) In a few sentences, tell us about the most complex multi-step task you've owned in a previous role and how you kept it error-free.

3) List the software tools you're most comfortable with.

4) Message us here with a link to a 60-second selfie-style video introducing yourself, in clear spoken English, telling us why you'd be great in this role (Google Drove or Loom is best).



**Applications that don't follow these steps exactly will not be reviewed. Attention to detail starts here.**

ntum.

title: Experienced Shopee Product Research & Listing Specialist
description:
We are a Japanese e-commerce company starting and scaling a Shopee Singapore store.



We are looking for an EXPERIENCED Shopee specialist — not a general data-entry VA.



Our first goal is to publish 500–1,000 competitive listings and generate sales as quickly as possible.



At the beginning, we especially value your Shopee experience and knowledge. We want someone who can not only perform the work, but also explain the research and listing methods that have worked for them.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Product Research

- Research products on Shopee Singapore

- Analyze Top Sales / Sold per Month

- Find successful sellers and their best-selling products

- Analyze seller information such as number of products, ratings, followers, shop age, and sales performance

- Identify products with strong sales potential



2. Amazon Japan Product Matching

- Find the exact same product on Amazon.co.jp

- Confirm that the Shopee product and Amazon product are identical

- Record Amazon URL / ASIN / price

- Help evaluate whether the product can be sold profitably on Shopee Singapore



3. Shopee Listing

- Create accurate Shopee listings

- Create optimized English titles and descriptions

- Select correct categories and attributes

- Set variations, prices, weight and shipping information

- Publish listings accurately and efficiently



4. Product Images

- Create/improve the main product image

- Experience with Canva or similar image tools is preferred

- Images should be suitable for Shopee and visually competitive



5. Documentation

This is very important.



We want you to document and explain your workflow, including:

- How you find products likely to sell

- How you identify good competitor stores

- How you decide whether a product is worth listing

- How you create Shopee product images

- How you create listings efficiently

- Any techniques or methods you have learned from your previous Shopee experience



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have actual experience with Shopee.



We strongly prefer candidates who have experience with:

- Shopee Singapore

- Shopee product research

- Shopee product listing

- Competitor/store research

- Finding best-selling products

- Amazon Japan or Japanese products

- Dropshipping or cross-border e-commerce

- Canva/product image creation



IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone whose experience is only general data entry, Shopify, Amazon, or eBay.



Actual Shopee experience is important.



When applying, please answer these questions:



1. Which Shopee marketplaces have you worked on?

2. How long have you worked with Shopee?

3. Approximately how many Shopee products have you listed?

4. Have you done product research using Top Sales, Sold per Month, or competitor stores?

5. Please explain your Shopee product research process.

6. Have you ever sourced products from Amazon Japan?

7. Have you worked with dropshipping or cross-border Shopee stores?

8. Please provide examples or screenshots of Shopee stores/listings you have worked on, if possible.

9. What tools do you use for product research, images, and listing?

10. What results did the Shopee stores you worked on achieve?



SHORT PAID TEST



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a paid practical test.



The test will involve researching products on Shopee Singapore, identifying matching products on Amazon Japan, explaining why you selected them, and preparing a sample Shopee listing.



We are willing to pay more for someone with strong, proven Shopee experience.



There is an opportunity for long-term work and potentially a leadership role as we expand the Shopee operation.

title: AI Content Production & Systems Virtual Assistant
description:
### Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | 30-Day Paid Trial



I’m looking for a creative, organized, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help me build and manage multiple faceless social media content channels.



This is **not a traditional administrative VA position**.



I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys AI, social media, storytelling, content creation, and figuring out better ways to get things done.



You’ll initially work closely with me to learn my content style and production process. Over time, my goal is for you to independently take a content idea from **research → script → visual creation → video → final organized deliverable**.



An important part of this role will also be helping me **develop, document, and improve our content-production systems and SOPs** so that we can produce content efficiently and consistently.



## What You'll Help With



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching interesting, viral, evergreen, and trending content ideas

* Researching competitors and successful content formats

* Writing and improving hooks and scripts using AI

* Fact-checking information before it is used in content

* Creating AI image prompts

* Generating AI images and video assets

* Turning images into AI video clips

* Creating AI voiceovers

* Editing short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Adding captions, sound effects, music, B-roll, and other retention-focused editing

* Creating thumbnails, covers, and simple graphics

* Organizing content files and assets

* Maintaining a content calendar

* Tracking content through the production process

* Repurposing content across platforms

* Documenting repeatable workflows and creating SOPs

* Testing new AI tools and recommending ways to improve our workflow



Eventually, I would like to be able to give you a topic or content direction and have you manage most of the production process independently.



## Tools



Experience with some of the following is strongly preferred:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Higgsfield

* OpenArt

* Kling

* Google Veo

* Runway

* Midjourney or other AI image generators

* ElevenLabs or other AI voice tools

* CapCut

* Canva

* Google Drive

* Google Docs/Sheets

* Notion, ClickUp, Trello, or similar project-management tools



**You do NOT need experience with every tool listed above.**



I'm much more interested in someone who understands AI-assisted content creation and can quickly learn new tools.



## The Person I'm Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



* Have excellent written English

* Have strong visual judgment

* Understand what makes short-form content engaging

* Are comfortable experimenting with AI tools

* Can follow detailed instructions

* Can also figure things out independently

* Are highly organized

* Pay close attention to details

* Communicate clearly when something isn't working

* Can research solutions before immediately asking for help

* Are comfortable receiving constructive feedback

* Can reproduce an established visual/content style consistently

* Enjoy documenting processes and improving systems

* Are dependable with deadlines



I'm especially interested in candidates who have experience with **faceless TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, AI storytelling, YouTube automation, or AI-generated video content.**



## Hours



We will begin at approximately **10–15 hours per week**.



There is potential for additional hours and a long-term position as our content channels grow.



The schedule can be reasonably flexible, but communication and meeting agreed-upon deadlines are important.



## 30-Day Paid Trial



The position will begin with a **30-day paid trial period**.



During the trial, we'll evaluate:



* Quality of work

* Reliability

* Communication

* Attention to detail

* Creativity

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to learn new tools

* Ability to work independently

* Speed and efficiency

* Ability to document and improve workflows



The trial is also an opportunity for you to determine whether the position is a good fit for you.



Either party may end the working relationship during the trial period. All approved work completed through the termination date will be paid according to our agreed terms.



Successful candidates may be offered an ongoing part-time position after the trial.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application:



1. Tell me about your experience creating social media content, especially faceless or AI-generated content.



2. Which AI image and video generation tools have you personally used?



3. Which video editing software do you use most often?



4. Please send 2–3 examples of videos or content you personally created. Clearly explain which parts you created yourself.



5. Imagine I give you this topic:



**“A strange Florida law most people don't know exists.”**



Briefly explain how you would turn that idea into a 30–60 second faceless video.



6. Tell me about a process or workflow you have improved or documented in a previous role.



7. If an AI video generation tool keeps producing an incorrect or distorted result, what would you do before asking me for help?



8. What internet speed do you currently have?



9. What computer/device do you use for video editing?



10. How many hours per week are you currently available?



11. What hourly rate are you seeking?



12. What is your favorite AI tool right now, and why?



### IMPORTANT



At the very beginning of your application, write:

title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:

About Us

2. Loom Video (Answer the questions below)

title: Lead List Building & Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



FlowLead runs cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation.



Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used?

5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market?

6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it.



Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.



You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.

title: Senior Recruiter (RPO) – Full-Cycle Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing
description:
Senior Recruiter (RPO) – Full-Cycle Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing



Company: Contact Marketers LLC

Experience: 3–5+ Years

Position Type: Full-Time, Hands-On Individual Contributor



ABOUT THE ROLE



Contact Marketers LLC is seeking an experienced Senior Recruiter to support our Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) clients.



This is a hands-on recruiting and headhunting position—not a people-management role. You will not have direct reports.



We need someone who knows how to proactively find great candidates, including passive candidates who aren't actively applying for jobs. You will personally manage searches from initial client intake and candidate sourcing through interviews, offers, and successful placement.



If you are a recruiter who enjoys hunting for talent, building candidate pipelines, and filling difficult positions, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Proactively source active and passive candidates for client openings.



• Use LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, resume databases, job boards, Boolean search, professional networks, referrals, Google, and other sourcing methods.



• Conduct direct outreach through LinkedIn,
, phone, text, and other appropriate channels.



• Develop sourcing strategies for specialized and difficult-to-fill positions.



• Conduct phone and video candidate screenings.



• Evaluate candidates for experience, skills, compensation, availability, communication, and overall fit.



• Present qualified candidates to clients with clear candidate summaries.



• Conduct job-intake meetings with clients and hiring managers.



• Translate hiring requirements into effective sourcing and recruiting strategies.



• Manage multiple open positions and candidate pipelines simultaneously.



• Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.



• Maintain consistent candidate and client follow-up throughout the hiring process.



• Coordinate background checks and required pre-employment documentation.



• Support offer preparation, candidate negotiations, and offer acceptance.



• Maintain accurate candidate and recruiting activity in the ATS/CRM.



• Take ownership of each search from intake through successful placement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• 3–5+ years of professional recruiting or talent acquisition experience.



• Strong full-cycle recruiting experience.



• Demonstrated success sourcing and headhunting passive candidates.



• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, resume databases, job boards, Boolean search, and direct candidate outreach.



• Experience conducting candidate screens and interviews.



• Experience managing multiple job requisitions simultaneously.



• Experience working directly with hiring managers and/or external recruiting clients.



• Strong written and verbal communication skills.



• Excellent organization, follow-up, and candidate-management skills.



• Experience using ATS and recruiting CRM platforms.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), staffing agencies, executive search, direct-hire recruiting, agency recruiting, corporate talent acquisition, or difficult-to-fill professional positions is strongly preferred.  We offer monthly performance bonuses.  



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE?



You're a recruiter and headhunter first.



When you're given a difficult position, your first thought isn't:



"Where should I post this job?"



It's:



"Where are these people working right now, and how do I reach them?"



You know how to research a market, identify potential candidates, build a target list, conduct outreach, generate interest, qualify candidates, and keep the recruiting process moving.



You don't depend solely on inbound applicants. You're comfortable approaching passive candidates and persistent about follow-up.



Most importantly, you take ownership of getting positions filled.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



Success will be based on qualified candidates sourced and submitted, interviews generated, candidate response rates, time-to-fill, offer acceptance, successful placements, hiring manager satisfaction, and overall candidate experience.



IMPORTANT: HOW TO APPLY



We want candidates who pay attention to details.



When submitting your application, include the word HEADHUNTER in the subject line or at the top of your application.



Applications that include HEADHUNTER will receive priority consideration.



ABOUT CONTACT MARKETERS



Contact Marketers LLC provides specialized staffing and Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) solutions to businesses that need experienced recruiting support.



Our RPO team helps clients keep their candidate pipelines full and their hiring processes moving—from candidate sourcing and screening through interviews, background checks, offers, and hiring.

description:
We need one video editor to own our short-form ad output long term. $1,700/month plus 20% commission on every sale your videos generate. We supply the AI video account (Higgsfield), so you are not burning your own credits.



This is direct-response editing for TikTok and Reels, not video production. If your reel is weddings, corporate work, or long-form YouTube, we will not be a good client for you.



WHO WE ARE



VNG Labs. We are a US-based ecommerce brand selling research compounds and lab supplies, shipping from the US, with a live storefront and repeat customers. Creative is the lever that moves our number, which is why this role exists and why it is paid the way it is.



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



- Producing 8-12 short vertical ads per week, 15-30 seconds, 9:16

- Generating the visuals yourself with AI - we do not have a warehouse of product footage, so a large share of every ad is something you generate, not something you cut

- Writing your own hooks and on-screen text, and building multiple hook variants of anything that works

- Re-cutting winners into new angles instead of starting from zero

- Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards

- Exporting to spec with captions burned in



TOOLS



Premiere Pro, CapCut or After Effects, and real fluency in Veo 3 and Seedance through Higgsfield - including the higher-end models, not the cheap tiers. Second nature, not "I have tried it once." We pay for the account.



THE CATEGORY, SO NOBODY IS SURPRISED



Our products are research compounds sold for laboratory research use only. It is a regulated category with hard creative rules: no health claims, no before-and-after, no promising results, no implying a person takes these. Every ad has to sell on brand, proof and testing instead. If you have worked in a restricted category before, you already know this shape.



WHAT WE OFFER



- $1,700 per month, full-time, 40 hours

- 20% commission on every sale your videos generate, tracked through your own link, for as long as you work with us. This is the real upside and it is uncapped.

- We pay for the AI tools

- Loom feedback on every batch, and we show you exactly how your ads performed

- Work when you work best - deadlines, not fixed hours, with some overlap with US Eastern

- Long-term. We want someone for years, not a project.



HOW TO APPLY



Message us here with the subject line in exactly this format:



VIAL | [your name] | [years editing short-form ads] | [months using Veo 3 or Seedance]



Example: VIAL | Anna Cruz | 3 | 7



Then in the body, exactly these six lines. Links only. No CV, no attachments, no cover letter.



1. Best short-form ad you edited (link):

2. What it sold and how it did (numbers if you have them - "I don't have the numbers" is a fine answer):

3. Best video you made with Veo 3 or Seedance (link):

4. Tools used, and which parts are AI vs filmed:

5. One editing decision in the ad from line 1 - timestamp (mm:ss) and why, max 2 sentences:

6. Loom link, 90 seconds max, camera on:



For line 6: open one of your own videos on screen and talk us through one editing decision and why you made it. We want to hear how you think, not just what you can cut.



You will be skipped for: wrong subject format, a CV instead of links, attachments, weddings or corporate work, invented numbers, or anything that could have been sent to any company.



We reply to everyone who follows the format.

title: Experienced Corporate Legal Operations Specialist
description:
Corporate Focus | Independent Contractor | Remote



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Corporate Legal Operations Specialist to provide remote legal support to our growing business law firm. The role will focus on business entity formations, corporate governance, annual reports and other corporate filings, business transactions and maintenance, corporate governance, annual reports and other corporate filings, and support for business transactions. 



Candidates with direct corporate or business-transaction experience is strongly preferred and will receive priority consideration. Experienced paralegals from other practice areas may also be considered if they  can demonstrate relevant transferable skills, independent matter management, and the ability to learn new areas quickly. The engagement is expected to begin at approximately 5 to 10 hours per week. As our firm's needs evolve and additional projects become available, there may be opportunities to take on additional work and increased hours. Applicants should be available for regular overlap with Pacific Time business hours for training, meetings, and collaboration with our team.



About Bend Law Group, PC



Bend Law Group is a boutique law firm that helps entrepreneurs and small businesses build, protect, and grow what they have created. From forming companies and raising capital to negotiating contracts and protecting intellectual property, we combine big-firm skill with small-firm humanity.



Our team is collaborative, responsive, and fully remote. We are built for people who want meaningful work, professional growth, and the flexibility of working remotely.



We believe exceptional client service begins with exceptional people. If you're looking for meaningful work, enjoy improving systems and processes, and want the flexibility of working remotely with a collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy experienced paralegal who can take ownership of assignments, independently handle routine corporate work after focused onboarding, and grow into more complex matters while supporting the day-to-day legal operations of our growing business law firm.



This position is intended to add experienced paralegal capacity to our team, not simply administrative support.  We are particularly interested in candidates who understand how individual assignments fit within the broader lifecycle of a legal matter and who can review a matter, determine its current status, identify outstanding tasks or missing information, and help move it toward completion.



You will receive onboarding and training in the firm's systems, procedures, templates, and workflows, along with targeted training in unfamiliar substantive areas. You should already have a solid foundation in paralegal work, including managing deadlines, handling detailed legal documents, communicating professionally, and independently managing established assignments, and recognizing when attorney guidance is required. 



Your initial responsibilities will focus primarily on entity formations and maintenance, corporate governance, compliance filings, corporate records, and business-transaction support. You will be expected to gather information from clients and attorneys, maintain complete and organized records, track deadlines, identify missing or inconsistent information, communicate proactively, and escalate substantive legal questions appropriately. As you become proficient with our systems and procedures, there will be opportunities to take ownership of more complex corporate, governance, and business-transaction projects. We value team members who take ownership of their work, communicate proactively, and consistently produce accurate, high-quality results. We are looking for someone who enjoys learning new technology, improving systems and processes, solving problems, and providing exceptional client service.



Key Responsibilities



• Prepare and submit government filings related to the formation and maintenance of corporations, limited liability companies, and other business entities. 



• Prepare and file articles of incorporation, articles of organization, annual reports, California Statements of Information, foreign qualifications, amendments, dissolutions, and other entity maintenance filings. 



• Assist attorneys with corporate governance and business-transaction matters, including written consents, resolutions, stock issuances, minute books, due diligence, closing checklists, signature packets, and post-closing organization.



• Review corporate records and supporting documents for completeness and consistency, identify potential issues, and escalate substantive legal questions to the supervising attorney.



• Review filing requirements and verify that all submissions are complete, accurate, and timely. 



• Identify opportunities to improve the firm's systems, workflows, templates, and internal processes.



• Gather information and supporting documentation from attorneys, staff members, clients, government agencies, and online resources. 



• Track filing deadlines, renewal dates, annual reports, and other corporate compliance requirements using the firm's calendaring and workflow systems. 



• Obtain business licenses and other government registrations as needed. 



• Maintain organized electronic corporate records, minute books, and other legal documentation. 



• Monitor the status of pending filings and communicate with government agencies, registered agents, clients, and attorneys regarding entity maintenance matters. 



• Enter and update information in the firm's practice management, document management, and workflow systems, including Microsoft 365, Clio, and other cloud-based legal technology platforms. 



• Assist with special projects and additional legal operations or administrative responsibilities as the firm's needs evolve.



• Maintain and improve written procedures, checklists, and training materials for recurring legal operations, helping ensure that the firm's institutional knowledge is documented and easily transferable across the team.



• As proficiency grows, serve as an additional experienced resource for the paralegal and support team by answering routine process questions, reviewing work when appropriate, reinforcing documented procedures, and escalating substantive legal issues to an attorney.



You Will Thrive Here If You Are



• Detail-Oriented and Reliable: You carefully review your work, follow instructions, and take ownership of deadlines.



• Highly Organized: You can manage multiple tasks and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



• Tech-Savvy: You learn new technology quickly and are comfortable working in cloud-based systems.



• A Strong Communicator: You have professional English verbal and written communication skills.



• Proactive: You anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and ask thoughtful questions.



• Team-Oriented: You enjoy collaborating with others and contributing to a supportive work environment.



• Self-Sufficient: You can independently complete established corporate paralegal assignments in a remote environment, exercise sound judgment, and know when to request attorney guidance.



• Service-Minded: You have a genuine passion for helping clients and colleagues.



• Positive and Resourceful: You bring a can-do attitude and look for solutions rather than dwelling on problems.



• Adaptable: You are willing to take on new responsibilities as the position and firm continue to grow.

Qualifications



• A minimum of two years of experience working in a paralegal role at a law firm or in-house legal department is required.



• Hands-on experience supporting corporate or business-transaction legal matters, including business entity formations, corporate governance, ongoing entity maintenance, or transactional closings, is strongly preferred and will be weighted heavily during candidate review.



• Experience with corporations, limited liability companies, and related formation, governance, maintenance, or compliance requirements is preferred.



• Experience preparing or supporting corporate governance documents and business transactions, such as board, stockholder, member, or manager consents; equity issuances; due diligence; closing checklists; and closing sets, is a plus.



• Demonstrated ability to manage paralegal assignments from intake through completion with limited supervision, learn new substantive areas efficiently, and recognize when to seek attorney input.



• Demonstrated ability to understand how individual tasks fit within the lifecycle of a legal matter, maintain continuity across multiple workstreams, and apply documented procedures consistently.



• Professional fluency in written and spoken English.



• Strong organizational and time-management skills.



• Careful attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.



• Ability to manage multiple assignments and shifting priorities.



• Ability to follow written procedures and document recurring processes.



• Comfort learning and using cloud-based legal, communication, and productivity systems.



• Ability to work effectively and communicate consistently in a fully remote environment.



• Experience supporting attorneys, executives, or professional-services firms is a plus.



• Availability for regular working-hour overlap with the Pacific Time Zone.



• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment.



• Experience with Clio and Microsoft 365 is preferred.



• Demonstrated ability to learn new software and technology quickly.



Schedule and Engagement



• Independent contractor position.



• Approximately five to 10 hours per week initially.



• Hours may increase as the candidate demonstrates proficiency and assumes additional responsibilities.



• Potential to transition into a substantially expanded or full-time role.



• Fully remote.



• Regular availability during Pacific Time business hours will be required.



Compensation and Benefits



• We anticipate paying $6 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience.



• Flexible remote-work arrangement.



• Opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities.



• Long-term collaboration with a supportive, values-driven team.



• Meaningful work helping entrepreneurs and small businesses.



• A culture built on kindness, clarity, teamwork, and zero tolerance for “law firm jerkiness.”



How to Apply



Please
 the following to 



• Resume (PDF) 



• A video introduction (maximum two minutes) 



• Your current location 



• Your desired hourly rate 



• Your general availability and the number of hours you are currently seeking 



• A brief list of the types of corporate or transactional matters you have personally worked on, if applicable



Video Introduction



In your video, please tell us:



• about your paralegal background and a complex matter you handled with limited supervision; 



• If you have corporate or business-transaction experience, please describe the types of matters and specific tasks you supported, and if your experience is in another practice area, please explain how your skills would transfer and how you would approach learning this work;



• which Bend Law Group value resonates with you most after reviewing our About Us page, and why; 



• about a technology, AI tool, or software platform you learned quickly and how it improved your work; and 



• what you believe would make you a valuable addition to our team?

Responding to Job Advertisement - Corporate Legal Operations Specialist

description:
ABOUT US

We are the honest-pricing company in an industry full of $10,000 kitchen-table sales pitches — we publish our prices, we install fast, and we back everything in writing.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Call and text customers after installation to confirm everything is working and answer questions

Handle service issues — take the call, understand the problem, d
 if it's a real defect or a misunderstanding, and coordinate the fix with our field team

Turn happy customers into reviews and referrals — ask for the Google review at the right moment

Save cancellations — when someone wants to cancel their plan, find out why and fix the real reason

Keep the CRM clean — every call logged, every issue tracked to closed

Escalate properly — you'll know what you can solve and what needs the owner



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:



Excellent spoken English. Clear, natural, easy for an American homeowner to understand. This is non-negotiable — you will be on the phone with US customers every day.

Comfortable on the phone. You'll make and take calls all day, including calls with upset people.

Calm under pressure. Some customers will call angry. You need to stay steady, listen, and solve.

2+ years in customer service, support, or account management. Home services, HVAC, plumbing, or trades experience is a big plus.

Reliable internet and a quiet workspace with a good headset. No background noise, no roosters, no traffic.

Available 11 AM – 9 PM US Eastern Time. (You will not be working every hour during this time, but you must be available during these hours)



Nice to have:



Spanish (a large portion of our customers are Spanish-speaking)

Experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or a similar CRM

Any technical or trades background

WHAT WE OFFER

Stable full-time position with a growing US company

Paid training on our systems and products

Performance bonuses tied to reviews collected and cancellations saved

Direct access to the owner — no layers of management

Real growth: this role becomes a team lead as we scale

HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed. This is intentional. Attention to detail is part of the job.



Step 1 — Write "SOFT WATER" as the first two words of your application



This tells us you read the whole posting.



Step 2 — Tell us in a few sentences

Your customer service experience

Your internet speed (run a speed test and give us the number)

Your setup: headset, workspace, background noise

Your available hours in US Eastern Time



Step 3 — Record a voice sample (THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART)



Record yourself on your phone or computer handling the scenario below, as if you are actually on the phone with the customer. Speak the whole thing out loud as one continuous recording, 2–3 minutes. Upload it to Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo and paste the link in your application. Make sure the link is set so anyone can listen.



Do not write out the answer. Do not read from a script in a flat voice. We want to hear how you actually sound talking to a real customer.



THE SCENARIO



You get a call from Mrs. Delgado. We installed her whole-home water filtration system three weeks ago. She is upset and talking fast.



Here is everything she tells you:



She was told the system drains water every night around 2 AM, but she has never heard it run once, so she is convinced it is broken.

She opened the salt tank and it "looks like just water" with no salt in it.

Our installer put the system in the middle of her patio and she hates where it is. She says she wants it moved to the corner.

She cut her hand on the outdoor faucet last week reaching behind the tank.

She just found out her neighbor paid $600 less for a system from another company and she wants to know why she paid more.

At the end she says: "Honestly I'm thinking about telling you to just come take the whole thing out."



Here is what you know internally:



The system regenerates roughly every 14 days, not nightly. Not hearing it is completely normal.

Salt sits underneath the water at the bottom of the brine tank. It looks like plain water on top. If there is truly no salt at the bottom, that is a real problem and needs a technician.

She is under a 1-year labor warranty, so a service visit costs her nothing.

Moving the system may or may not be possible depending on the plumbing — you cannot promise it on the call.

The neighbor's cheaper system is almost certainly a different, smaller unit without professional installation or a lifetime warranty.

We do not discount and we do not offer refunds to keep people happy. We fix problems instead.



Handle the call. We want to hear how you open, how you handle her being upset, what you tell her about each issue, what you promise, what you do not promise, and how you end the call.



WHAT WE'RE LISTENING FOR

Do you acknowledge her hand injury before jumping into explanations?

Do you let her feel heard, or do you immediately start correcting her?

Do you explain the 14-day cycle and the salt in a way a non-technical person understands?

Do you promise things you cannot deliver, or do you commit only to what you control?

Do you handle the price comparison without getting defensive and without discounting?

Do you turn a cancellation threat into a scheduled service visit?

Does your voice sound calm, warm, and confident?



There is no single perfect answer. We are evaluating your judgment and your delivery, not whether you hit a script.



TIMELINE



We review applications daily and reply to everyone who completes all three steps. Shortlisted candidates get a live video interview with the owner, followed by a paid trial week.



We are hiring for this role now.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: TRUST ACCOUNTANT - SHORT TERM ACCOMODATION AGENCY
description:
We are an Australian property business in the Blue Mountains, west of Sydney. We a short-stay holiday letting business that manages 25 properties for their owners.



We are looking for one careful, reliable bookkeeper to take over the day-to-day accounts work for the holiday letting business.



Here is the part that matters. Every week, guests pay money that belongs to our property owners, not to us. It arrives from Airbnb, 
 and direct bookings, in lump sums that do not match the individual bookings. Your job is to take those payouts apart, match every dollar — to the right booking and the right property, and make sure each owner gets paid exactly what they are owed at the end of the month.



If a number does not balance, we need to know about it that day. We do not want it smoothed over.



What you will do every week



Match platform payouts (Airbnb, 
, Stripe) against individual bookings in Guesty, allowing for platform commission, processing fees, refunds and chargebacks

Enter and code supplier invoices in Xero — cleaners, linen, gardeners, tradespeople

Keep each property's ledger up to date so we always know what it has earned and what it has cost

Chase missing invoices and unmatched payments

Flag anything that does not reconcile

What you will do every month



Prepare the bank reconciliation for review

Prepare owner statements: gross revenue, less our commission, less cleaning, linen, consumables and maintenance

Prepare the supplier payment run

Prepare a summary report by property: revenue, costs, occupancy

Prepare GST figures for our Australian accountant

What you will NOT do



You will not have authority to move money. You will not approve payments or be a bank signatory. Under Australian law those responsibilities stay with our licensed staff in Sydney. You prepare the work, we review and release it. This is not a limitation on you — it is how the regulation works here.



SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Essential



At least 2 years bookkeeping experience, including work for Australian or other international clients

Strong Xero skills — you should be comfortable with bank rules, manual journals, and reconciling accounts that do not balance easily

Confident with spreadsheets. You will be matching hundreds of line items and you need to be fast and accurate with lookups and pivots

Excellent written English. You will be writing owner statements and
s that Australian property owners will read

A stable internet connection and a working computer

Available to start within 4 weeks

Nice to have, not required



Experience with Guesty, Hostaway, Uplisting or another short-stay platform

Experience with Australian real estate trust accounting

Understanding of Australian GST

Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, or CPA

WHAT WE OFFER

Steady, long-term work. We are not looking for a short project — we want someone who is still here in five years

Paid Philippine public holidays and paid leave after 6 months

Genuine training on our systems, and a documented process for everything

A small team. You will work directly with our General Manager and with our existing VA, and you will hear directly from the business owner

Annual review and increase for good work

HOW TO APPLY

Please follow these instructions exactly. Applications that do not follow them will not be read.



Start your message with the word RECONCILE so we know you read the whole ad.

Tell us, in your own words, how you would handle this situation: a payout of AUD 4,820 lands in the bank account. Your system says the bookings in that payout period total AUD 5,110. What do you do?

Tell us how long you have used Xero and what kind of clients you used it for.

Tell us your internet speed and your available hours in Philippine time.

Attach your CV.

We read every application that follows the steps. We will reply to shortlisted applicants within one week, and there will be a short paid test task before we make an offer.

title: Elite Acquisitions Closer U.S. Real Estate | Remote | USD Pay
description:
We run a high margin U.S. real estate niche most investors can't touch: partial deeds and title problems. We help families untangle complicated ownership and unlock properties nobody else knows how to close. The deals are unusual, the margins are strong, and the best closer on our team is closing roughly one deal a week.



We're hiring one more sharp closer. The bar is high on purpose.





What This Is





A real sales seat. You research families, get on the phone every day, and build trust with people in hard situations.

This is not a VA role. Not admin. Not "manage a pipeline quietly." You dial, you talk, you move deals.

You'll own leads inside Lofty (our CRM), dial through Dialpad, and pull contacts with SmartSkip.





Your Day





Daily huddle, 10:00 AM ET, cameras on, no exceptions. We review numbers, wins, and blockers together.

75 dials per day minimum, tracked. Your dials, contacts, and conversion are visible to the team every day.

Roughly 40 to 50% research (obituaries, court and tax records, identifying heirs and the real decision maker) and 50 to 60% outreach (calls, texts, voi
s, follow up).

We run a two call close structure. You'll learn it cold.





How We Operate (so you know before you apply)





We track activity daily. If you go dark for a day with no heads up, you won't last here.

We coach hard and expect you to be coachable. B+ players who show up beat A players who don't.

Full training from day one. Clear path to Senior Closer and team lead as you prove out.







What You Need





English at C1/C2 only. Families need to trust your voice on the phone.

5+ years sales experience. Real estate (acquisitions, wholesaling, probate, title) strongly preferred.

Total comfort with daily outbound calling, voi
s, and relentless follow up.

Sharp judgment on who the real decision maker is inside a family.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset. Non negotiable.





Schedule





Full time, Monday to Friday

10:00 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time





Pay





Base: $1,000 to $1,500 USD per month based on experience

Commission: 10 to 15% depending on deal revenue. Our average deal is over $30,000, so a single close pays well.

Realistic total once ramped: $8,000 per month

Be clear eyed on timing: most reps lock their first deal within 30 days, and commission on that deal pays out around 100 days later once it closes and funds. This niche pays big, but it is not instant money. If you need a paycheck next week, this isn't the seat.







How to Apply



Send a 1 to 2 minute video covering:





Your sales and real estate background

How comfortable you truly are with heavy daily outbound calling

Why you're great at finding and speaking to the right decision maker in a family

Your location and availability

title: Strategic Cold Caller (Real Estate) – Seeking Sales & Customer Service Professionals
description:
AVAILABILITY:

Part-time availability (20 hours per week).

Must be willing to work on a Eastern Standard Time.

Preferably work 4 hours a day, 5 days a week.

Able to work from Monday to Friday.



REQUIREMENTS:

Noise Cancelling Headset

Own Headset and Computer/Laptop

High Speed Internet must be acceptable speeds



PREFERENCE:

We are looking for an Acquisitions Cold Caller (Real Estate) with at least 1-2 years of cold-calling experience, specifically in outbound sales or customer service. A background in real estate is required, and we strongly prefer candidates with experience in Skip Tracing, Probate, Surplus Funds or Unclaimed Funds.



The ideal candidate is outgoing, personable, and able to build rapport quickly. Strong communication skills and excellent customer service are essential. We are looking for someone who is ambitious, driven, and results-oriented while maintaining a humble and approachable demeanor. title: Lead List Building & Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



FlowLead runs cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation.



Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE



We need someone who can think independently and critically.



After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself.



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn the targeting rules for each client.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools.

- Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies.

- Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search.

- Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client.

- Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps.

- Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early.

- Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help.

- Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience.

- Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows.

- Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms.

- Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Honest about errors and willing to correct them.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

- Interested in a long-term position.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, Monday-Friday.

- 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time.

- Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments.

- Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually.

- Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead.



HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1



Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time?

3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research?

4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used?

5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market?

6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help?

7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable?

8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it.



Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you.



HIRING PROCESS



1. We review your written answers.

2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video.

3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment.

4. Final candidates join a video call with us.



You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.
