title: Senior Bookkeeper - Odoo / Canadian Corporations / GST-QST
description:
Position: Remote Senior Bookkeeper

Schedule: Initial full-time cleanup project, transitioning to long-term part-time

Compensation: Hourly, based on experience

Long-term workload: Approximately 5-10 hours per week



++About GrayRock Consulting++



GrayRock Consulting operates a small group of Canadian and US companies.



Our current structure includes:

-Two Canadian IT consulting companies

-One Canadian holding company

-One US e-commerce company



We may add an additional US company in the future to support US IT consulting activities.



We operate in an AI-first environment and actively look for opportunities to automate repetitive administrative and accounting work.



Our accounting system is Odoo using a multi-company setup.



++The Role++



We are looking for an experienced, autonomous bookkeeper who understands Canadian corporate bookkeeping, Quebec GST/QST, and Odoo Accounting.



This is not an entry-level bookkeeping or generic data-entry position.



We currently have approximately 24 months of bookkeeping backlog that needs to be brought up to date. Transaction volume is relatively low, approximately 50-100 transactions per month.



The immediate priority is bringing our Canadian companies current, completing reconciliations and month-end activities, and preparing and filing outstanding GST/QST returns with Revenu Québec.



We expect the initial cleanup to require close to full-time availability for approximately 1-3 weeks.



Once the backlog is under control, this will become an ongoing part-time role averaging approximately 5-10 hours per week.



++Responsibilities++



Your initial responsibilities will include:

-Clean up approximately two years of bookkeeping backlog

-Perform bank and credit-card reconciliations

-Enter and properly classify expenses and revenues

-Review existing transactions for errors, duplicates, omissions, and incorrect classifications

-Perform month-end bookkeeping activities

-Reconcile GST/QST accounts

-Prepare and file GST/QST returns with Revenu Québec

-Work with approximately two bank accounts per entity

-Manage bookkeeping across multiple companies within Odoo

-Properly account for intercompany transactions between operating companies and the holding company

-Investigate unexplained transactions before escalating questions

-Maintain accurate supporting documentation and audit trails



Over time, responsibilities may also include:

-Payroll and source-deduction accounting within Odoo

-T4/T5 preparation

-US e-commerce bookkeeping

-Supplier and contractor invoice processing

-Preparing invoices and approved expenses for payment

-Maintaining accounts payable records

-Ongoing monthly close and tax-compliance preparation

-Additional accounting responsibilities as trust and experience develop



Our CPA is primarily involved at year-end. We therefore need someone who can own the day-to-day books independently, rather than relying on a CPA to continually correct or supervise the bookkeeping.



++Required Experience++



You must have:

-Hands-on experience with Odoo Accounting

-Experience working with Odoo multi-company environments

-Professional bookkeeping experience for Canadian corporations

-Hands-on experience with Quebec GST/QST

-Experience preparing GST/QST returns

-Experience with bank and credit-card reconciliations

-Understanding of Canadian corporate bookkeeping practices

-Experience with intercompany transactions and reconciliations

-Strong written and spoken English

-Strong attention to detail

-Ability to investigate accounting issues independently

-Ability to work with incomplete or imperfect historical information

-Ability to manage priorities without constant supervision



This position requires someone who can look at an accounting issue, investigate it, propose the correct treatment, and ask focused questions when management input is actually required.



++Nice to Have++



These are advantages but are not required:

-Canadian payroll/source-deduction experience

-T4/T5 preparation experience

-US bookkeeping experience

-E-commerce accounting experience

-Experience cleaning up significant bookkeeping backlogs

-Experience with accounting automation

-Experience working with AI-assisted accounting workflows



++AI-First Working Environment++



GrayRock is an AI-oriented company.



We actively automate repetitive workflows and expect our bookkeeper to be comfortable working with AI-assisted processes.



For example, we are currently developing an AI agent to process expense information and prepare structured data for import into Odoo.



We are not looking for someone whose value is simply manually entering transactions.



We want someone who understands the accounting well enough to validate automated outputs, identify exceptions, maintain the integrity of the books, and help us continuously improve the process.



You do not need to be an AI developer.



You do need to be comfortable working in an environment where automation will continually replace repetitive manual accounting work.



++Working Hours++



There is no requirement to work Canadian business hours.



You may work primarily during Philippine business hours.



Meetings can be scheduled when necessary at mutually convenient times, including early or late Eastern Time.



During the initial cleanup, you should have enough availability to work close to full-time for approximately 1-3 weeks.



Afterward, the expected workload is approximately 5-10 hours per week.





++How to Apply++



Please read this section carefully.



Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be reviewed.



Start your application with exactly:

GR-ODOO-CA



Then answer the following questions using the same numbers:



1. Odoo experience

How many years have you worked directly with Odoo Accounting? Briefly describe the most complex Odoo accounting environment you have managed.



2. Multi-company experience

Describe your experience using Odoo in a multi-company environment, including any experience with intercompany transactions.



3. Canadian experience

How many Canadian corporations have you performed bookkeeping for? What Canadian tax filings or remittances have you personally prepared?



4. Quebec GST/QST

Describe your direct experience with Quebec GST/QST. Have you personally prepared and filed GST/QST returns with Revenu Québec?



5. Technical question

Before filing a GST/QST return for a Quebec corporation, what accounts, transactions, and reports would you review or reconcile in Odoo? Please explain your process briefly.



6. Cleanup experience

Describe one bookkeeping cleanup or backlog project you personally handled. How far behind were the books, what problems did you find, and what did you do to bring them current?



7. Availability

How many hours per week can you commit during the next three weeks? When could you start?



8. Rate

What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



9. AI and automation



Give one example of how you have used AI, automation, imports, rules, or another tool to reduce repetitive bookkeeping work. If you have not done this previously, briefly explain how you feel about working with AI-assisted accounting processes.



Do not send a generic cover letter.



We are specifically looking for someone with Odoo + Canadian corporate bookkeeping experience, with Quebec GST/QST experience strongly prioritized.



Applications that do not begin with GR-ODOO-CA and answer all nine questions will not be considered.

title: Onboarding Specialist / CSR
description:
To be considered, you must fill out the application form below:





Ansible Health is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Onboarding Specialist / Customer Service Representative (CSR) to join our innovative team. As a key member of our patient-centric approach to healthcare delivery, you will play a crucial role in ensuring a smooth onboarding process for new patients and providing exceptional customer service.



What is AnsibleHealth?

AnsibleHealth unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We are looking for a top-tier Onboarding Specialist / CSR to become an integral part of our expanding team. This role is vital in delivering superior customer service, handling patient communications, and providing essential support to our clinical staff in their mission to offer exceptional care. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exemplary professionalism, excellent English language communication skills, and outstanding organizational abilities with meticulous attention to detail. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to our patient-centric approach in healthcare delivery.



Responsibilities

- Customize initial discussions based on patient needs, ensuring they understand how the program can address their specific health conditions, providing personalized benefits rather than general services.

- Manage inquiries through multiple communication channels (phone,
, etc.), including voi
 inbox management and message routing, providing prompt and accurate responses.

- Process and manage referrals, working towards efficient conversion within a 7-10 day timeframe while managing multiple referral loop processes for a large patient panel.

- Perform comprehensive data entry including clinical survey scores/results, diagnostic tests, remote physiologic monitoring (RPM), and remote therapeutic monitoring (RTM) data streams.

- Schedule and coordinate patient appointments while maintaining communication with patients regarding their care schedule.

- Manage and process inbound and outbound medical records, ensuring proper documentation and organization.

- Maintain accurate EMR records by updating care notes, face sheets, and ensuring the integrity of patient information.

- Attend clinical meetings, take detailed notes, and follow up on action items and project timelines.

- Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of physicians, engineers, designers, and care team members to continuously improve patient care delivery.

- Resolve patient issues and complaints, identifying problems and finding appropriate solutions to ensure patient satisfaction while maintaining professional communication throughout the process.

- Achieve daily call quotas of 75-100 interactions.

- Adhere to established performance metrics to qualify for incentive plans tied to performance.





The ideal candidate for this role at Ansible Health is a dynamic professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment. They should also possess exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, coupled with meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational abilities. They should be adept at managing multiple priorities, from patient onboarding to referral management.





Required Qualifications and Competencies

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Nursing, Physical Therapy, or other healthcare-related fields.

- Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in customer service, preferably in a healthcare and/or sales environment.

- Sales experience or demonstrated ability to effectively communicate value propositions.

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to explain complex medical concepts in easily understandable terms.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficiency with CRM systems, EMR software, and standard office applications (e.g., Google Suite).

- Typing speed of at least 60 words per minute.

- Reliable internet connection (at least 30 Mbps) and a quiet home environment for work.

- Ability to work in US time zones (EST)



Nice to have

- Experience in the healthcare industry or with medical terminology.

- Proven track record in sales.

- Familiarity with remote patient monitoring systems.

- Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and healthcare privacy practices.





Job Details

Full-time: A minimum of 40 hours a week

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work Pacific/Eastern hours)

Benefits:

- Paid Time Off

- HMO Coverage on 3rd month

- With incentives



Best of luck!

title: Beauty Content Editor / Social Media Assistant — Part-Tim
description:
Starting Pay: $5 USD/hour

Starting Hours: Approximately 3-5 hours/week

Pay Schedule: Biweekly

Location: Remote

Opportunity to grow into a higher-paid Social Media Manager position



About the Role:



I own a permanent makeup (PMU) studio and am looking for a creative, detail-oriented person to help me edit photos and create polished social media content for Instagram and TikTok.



To start, this will be a small part-time position focused primarily on professional photo editing/retouching and creating content from photos and videos that I provide.



I’m looking for someone with a strong eye for beauty content who understands that editing PMU work requires attention to detail. Photos should look polished and professional without being overly filtered or edited to the point where the actual results are misrepresented.



There is no formal education or professional qualification required. I care much more about your portfolio, creativity, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and the effort you put into your work.



For the right person, I would love for this position to eventually grow into a larger Social Media Manager role with more hours and higher pay.



What You’ll Initially Help With:



* Professionally edit and retouch PMU photos

* Skin retouching and airbrushing while keeping results natural

* Correct lighting, color, cropping, backgrounds, etc.

* Edit before-and-after photos

* Turn raw photos/videos I provide into Instagram and TikTok content

* Edit short-form videos/Reels

* Create simple graphics, carousels or social posts when needed

* Follow the existing branding and aesthetic of my business

* Research current beauty, PMU, Instagram and TikTok trends

* Bring forward content ideas that could work well for my business

* Create approximately a couple of finished posts per week to start



Who I’m Looking For:



I am specifically looking for a female candidate for this role. You don’t necessarily need previous experience working specifically with a permanent makeup artist, but experience with beauty, aesthetics, makeup, skincare, salons, tattoos or similar visual industries is a big plus.



You should:



* Have a strong eye for aesthetics and detail

* Be comfortable with professional photo retouching/airbrushing

* Have experience with Photoshop, Lightroom, Canva, CapCut or similar editing programs

* Understand Instagram and TikTok content

* Be willing to research current trends rather than waiting for me to provide every idea

* Be creative and able to take direction

* Be willing to learn about the permanent makeup industry

* Communicate well and meet deadlines

* Be open to feedback and revisions

* Care about producing high-quality work rather than simply finishing a task



IMPORTANT — Portfolio Required



Please only apply if you can provide examples of relevant work.



When applying, please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your portfolio

3. Examples of photo retouching/Photoshop/airbrushing work

4. Examples of Reels, TikToks, graphics or social media content you have created

5. Any Instagram/TikTok accounts or feeds you currently manage or have previously managed

6. The editing programs you use

7. Your current availability



Please only send work relevant to photo editing, content creation, beauty or social media. I do not need to see unrelated administrative, accounting, data entry, etc. work.



Beauty-industry experience is preferred but not required if you have a strong portfolio.



Pay & Growth



Starting pay is $5 USD/hour for approximately 5 hours per week ($25 USD/week), paid biweekly.



This is intentionally a small position to start because I want to find the right person and see how well we work together.



If you’re reliable, creative and consistently produce great work, I would like to gradually give you more responsibility and hours.



My goal is eventually to have someone who understands my brand well enough to take on a larger Social Media Manager position, including content planning, posting, trend research and helping grow the business’s social media presence.



That position would come with increased hours and higher compensation.



I’m looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship rather than just completing a few one-time editing projects.

title: Claude AI Systems Builder and Specialist
description:
This is not a beginner role. If you are not able to quickly navigate AI and the tools that accompany this role, I will notice immediately.



This role is for someone who lives inside Claude full-time, 8 hours a day, five days a week, and becomes the resident expert on building workflows, automations, custom agents, skills, and connectors. You'll take ideas directly from leadership and turn them into working builds. You will turn each of the teams Claude's accounts into a Super Claude account, and all of our clients' Claude accounts into Super Claude accounts. Think of Jarvis from Marvel. You will host team training sessions on Claude, projects, and other items we need to be aware of.



There will be times when I want something developed exactly as it is presented on social media. Social media is where I will get 80% of my ideas. If someone shows that they have built a workflow, automation, custom agent, skills, connectors, etc., I need you to figure out how they did it, tell me exactly what they did, and show me how by recreating the exact same thing they posted on social media. I want to replicate some of the most impressive AI demonstration videos to make them useful in my business. Take a demonstration video and turn it into a real-world Claude function for the business.



Where something isn't feasible yet, you'll research and develop a roadmap for how it could work down the line, even if that's months out, and present that plan clearly. If you can't figure out how someone built a workflow, automation, or custom agent, I need you to explain where the bottleneck is and how you'll get around it.



You'll also be responsible for structuring and organizing projects, using Claude artifacts, Claude projects, Claude Design, Google Drive, Notion, etc., and for teaching leadership how these systems work along the way. You'll collaborate closely with the assistant and broader team, handing off design or presentation work rather than building it yourself. I never want to hear "can't be done" — I want to see options. Never present me with something that doesn't work or isn't what I asked you to build.



This is a hands-on, deep-focus role, not a supervisory one. I don't want to supervise you. When you're working your hours, I won't be monitoring you — I expect the work to get done and the final product shared with me. You'll never have nothing to do: if I don't have a project queued up for you, it's your responsibility to be proactive. This isn't just my business — once you join, it's our team, and if you're not actively thinking about where the team can go and what we can improve without being told, this isn't the right role for you.



The business working hours are 8/9AM–5 PM PST. Please let me know your availability.



There is an honor-system arrangement: consistent pay every week, in exchange for trust that the work is genuinely getting done without the business owners having to micromanage you.



You'll also be client-facing at times — comfortable joining a Zoom call and answering a client's questions live, not just building behind the scenes.



Familiarity with the real estate industry is a plus, and while general AI literacy is a must, the bulk of your time and expertise must be Claude-specific. You'll need to know how to use other AI systems, but the vast majority of your time — 95% of it — will be spent building and working within Claude. This is not a job where you learn how Claude works as you go. If you are not immediately familiar with every aspect of Claude, this job is not for you.



I'm not hiring for something short-term. I want someone who wants to grow with the business for years, and this would be your priority. I value loyalty, look for it, and will provide you with stability and a consistent job.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (AI + Photoshop, E-commerce & Marketing Assets)
description:
[Senior Graphic Designer (AI + Photoshop, E-commerce & Marketing Assets)]



Job Overview

We are looking for a skilled graphic designer to help create polished and realistic product images and marketing assets for e-commerce and digital marketing.



The work will involve using AI image-generation or editing tools together with Adobe Photoshop. You will receive product images, visual examples, and clear instructions for each project.



We are looking for someone with strong visual judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to turn reference images into professional-quality final artwork.



Responsibilities

- Create polished product images, static ads, social media graphics, blog imagery, web assets, and infographics

- Create short AI-generated videos and product animations for digital marketing

- Composite, retouch, and refine AI-generated images to achieve realistic lighting, texture, perspective, shadows, and product details

- Develop creative concepts and visual solutions based on project briefs, references, and marketing objectives, including visual and competitor research to identify creative direction

- Follow provided product references and project instructions accurately while maintaining product consistency

- Correct AI artifacts and review work carefully before submission to ensure quality, consistency, and accuracy

- Prepare organized working files and properly formatted final image and video exports

- Manage multiple assignments and shifting priorities, communicate clearly and provide updates when needed, and complete work within agreed deadlines



Requirements

- 5+ years of professional graphic design experience

- Strong attention to realism, proportions, materials, lighting, and product details

- Experience with realistic photo manipulation or product compositing

- Experience creating e-commerce or product listing images

- Experience creating short marketing videos or product animations (AI-generated or edited)

- Able to follow visual references and written instructions accurately

- Strong text-based communication and instruction comprehension in English (our team coordinates work almost entirely in writing)

What matters most is the ability to apply visual elements such as images, color swatches, and product thumbnails to the Variant and Option area, and to build that with Shopify Liquid, JavaScript, and related technologies so customers can select product options intuitively.



We are looking for someone who understands the brand's design direction and business goals, and can analyze an existing Shopify theme to build or improve what is needed.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design and use product data structures with Shopify Metafields and Metaobjects

- Build scalable code structures that apply across many products and collections

title: Executive Assistant to Founder | Long-Term Remote Role | $700+ USD/Month
description:
Full-Time | Permanent Work From Home | U.S. Eastern Time Hours

About the Role



I'm an entrepreneur who runs several online businesses, and I'm looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with me and become a key part of my day-to-day operations.



My biggest need is simple:



I need someone who can help keep me organized and make sure important things don't fall through the cracks.



There are always multiple projects, meetings, ideas, deadlines, messages, and tasks happening at the same time. I'm looking for someone who is naturally organized, follows up without being reminded, keeps track of details, and helps me stay focused on what needs my attention.



This is a long-term position. I'm looking for someone I can build a strong working relationship with and gradually trust with more responsibility over time.



What You'll Primarily Help Me With



Most of your work will involve:



Keeping my tasks, priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups organized

Maintaining my master task list in Notion

Taking tasks from messages, calls, voice notes, meetings, and screenshots and making sure they are tracked

Following up on things that are still outstanding

Helping coordinate projects across several businesses

Making sure I know what needs my attention each day

Joining a short daily call with me to review priorities

Organizing meeting notes and turning conversations into action items

Researching questions and giving me concise summaries

Keeping important documents and information organized

Flagging deadlines, blockers, or things I may have forgotten

Giving me a short update at the end of the day on what was completed and what is still open



You won't be expected to know everything on day one.



I'll teach you how my businesses operate, how I like things organized, and the systems we use.



Who I'm Looking For



Previous professional Executive Assistant experience is required.



You should have at least 1 year of experience directly supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, business owner, or senior executive.



More importantly, I'm looking for someone who is:



Extremely organized

Proactive

Reliable

Detail-oriented

Resourceful

A strong communicator

Excellent in spoken and written English

Comfortable managing many unrelated tasks at once

Able to work independently

Good at following up without being reminded

Comfortable asking good questions when something is unclear

A fast learner



One of the most important qualities I'm looking for is resourcefulness.



When you don't know how to do something, I want your first reaction to be:



"Let me look into it and see if I can figure it out."



AI, Marketing & E-Commerce



You do not need to be a marketer, media buyer, or AI expert.



However, my businesses involve a lot of:



AI and ChatGPT/Claude

Digital marketing

Google Ads and Meta Ads

E-commerce

Shopify

Business operations



So you'll naturally get exposure to these areas while working with me.



If you already have experience with any of them, that's great, but it is not required.



I'm happy to teach the right person.



For someone who is curious and wants to learn, this role can become a great opportunity to develop skills in AI, marketing, e-commerce, business operations, reporting, and project management.



Tools



We use tools such as:



Notion

Google Workspace

Google Sheets

Slack

ChatGPT

Claude



You do not need previous experience with every tool. If you're intelligent and comfortable with technology, you can learn them.



What You Can Expect From Me



You'll work directly with me and communicate with me regularly.



At first, I'll spend more time explaining how I work, my businesses, and what I need from you.



Over time, my goal is for you to become increasingly independent.



I don't want to micromanage someone forever. I want to develop a working relationship where you understand how I operate, recognize what needs to happen, and can increasingly take things off my plate.



You'll also have the opportunity to learn a lot about entrepreneurship, digital marketing, e-commerce, AI, advertising, and running online businesses.



Compensation & Growth



Starting compensation is around $70 USD per month, full-time.



This is not necessarily a hard maximum.



I'm willing to pay more for someone with stronger Executive Assistant experience, excellent English and communication skills, or particularly relevant experience.



There is also significant opportunity to earn more over time as you become more capable, independent, and valuable in the role.



I'm looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not just another short-term VA job.



Schedule



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



You must be comfortable working hours that overlap substantially with U.S. Eastern Time.



Please only apply if this schedule genuinely works for you long term.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your résumé

A short introduction telling me about your Executive Assistant experience

A 2–3 minute video introduction answering:

Who have you supported as an Executive Assistant?

What were your main responsibilities?

How do you personally keep track of many tasks and follow-ups at the same time?

Why do you think you'd be a good fit for this position?



Please speak naturally. Do not read an AI-generated script.



I'm not looking for a perfectly rehearsed presentation. I want to see how you naturally communicate and think.

About Us

We are a growing US-based consultancy specializing in strategic business operations, process improvement, and organizational growth. We build scalable systems, refine client workflows, and deliver structured advisory solutions. We value direct communication, clear processes, long-term working relationships, and respect for our team members' professional growth.

title: Recruiting & HR Coordinator — U.S. Companies
description:
About Market Workforce



Market Workforce provides recruiting, staffing, administrative, sales support and business operations services for a growing portfolio of U.S.-based companies.



We are building the systems and teams needed to support businesses across sales, technology, branded merchandise, marketing, distribution, manufacturing and other industries.



We are looking for an experienced Recruiting & HR Coordinator who can take ownership of our recruiting process.



This is not a temporary project.



We are looking for someone who can start by managing a high volume of sales applicants and eventually grow into a larger recruiting and HR leadership role within Market Workforce.



Your First Major Assignment



One of the companies we support, Aprinta, is currently building a national network of independent sales professionals across the United States.



We are receiving a significant number of applicants and need someone who can organize, screen and manage candidates from initial application through interview and onboarding.



You will be responsible for making sure qualified candidates move quickly through the process while unqualified applicants are identified and removed from the pipeline.



The goal is simple:



Management should only spend time speaking with the strongest candidates.



Primary Responsibilities

Applicant Management



You will:



Review incoming applications and resumes

Manage applicants from Indeed and other recruiting sources

Review candidate questionnaires

Screen candidates against established requirements

Categorize and score applicants

Identify high-priority candidates

Reject applicants who clearly do not meet requirements

Maintain accurate candidate records

Ensure candidates do not get lost in the recruiting process

Candidate Screening



For our initial sales recruiting program, you will look closely at:



B2B sales experience

Promotional products experience

Branded merchandise experience

Printing industry experience

Apparel/uniform sales experience

Packaging experience

Existing customer relationships

Existing books of business

Outside sales experience

Independent sales experience

Communication skills

Professionalism

Employment history

Entrepreneurial ability



You must be able to look beyond keywords on a resume and determine whether someone could actually be successful in the position.



Candidate Interviews



After initial training, you will conduct short first-round screening interviews with qualified candidates.



You will:



Schedule interviews

Conduct 10–15 minute screening calls

Follow our interview process

Ask standardized qualification questions

Take detailed interview notes

Score candidates

Recommend whether candidates should advance

Schedule qualified candidates for management interviews

Recruiting Pipeline Management



You will manage candidates through stages such as:



New Applicant → Application Review → Qualified → Screening Interview → Management Review → Approved → Agreement → Onboarding → Active



You will be responsible for keeping this pipeline clean and current.



We do not want hundreds of applicants sitting in the system without a clear status.



Recruiting Systems & Process Development



We are building our own internal recruiting and workforce management technology.



You will work with our management and technology teams to improve:



Recruiting workflows

Applicant scoring

Interview scorecards

Candidate communications

 templates

Rejection templates

Interview scheduling

Follow-up sequences

Recruiting reports

Onboarding checklists

Standard operating procedures

Recruiting dashboards



We want someone who sees a broken process and helps us improve it rather than simply working around it.



Future Responsibilities



This position will begin heavily focused on recruiting.



As Market Workforce grows, the right person may take responsibility for recruiting and HR coordination across multiple companies.



Future responsibilities may include:



Recruiting for additional departments

New employee onboarding

Independent contractor onboarding

Employee documentation

Offer letters

Contractor agreements

Personnel records

Training coordination

Employee/contractor communications

Recruiting analytics

Hiring manager coordination

Building recruiting SOPs

Managing additional recruiting coordinators



There is significant opportunity for the right person to grow with the company.



Required Experience



We are looking for someone with:



2+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition or HR coordination experience

Experience reviewing resumes and applications

Experience conducting candidate screening interviews

Strong written English

Strong spoken English

Excellent organizational skills

Strong attention to detail

Ability to make independent decisions

Experience working with U.S.-based companies preferred

Experience working remotely

Comfortable working with high applicant volume



Experience with Indeed, LinkedIn, ATS platforms, recruiting CRMs or similar systems is strongly preferred.



Who Will Succeed Here



We want someone who is:



Organized.

You can manage hundreds of applicants without losing track of people.



Decisive.

You are comfortable determining that a candidate is not qualified and moving on.



A strong judge of people.

You understand that a good resume does not necessarily mean someone will be a good salesperson or employee.



Process-oriented.

You naturally think about how systems can be improved.



Fast.

Good candidates should not wait several days because nobody reviewed their application.



Detail-oriented.

Candidate records, notes, statuses and follow-ups need to be accurate.



Comfortable with technology.

We are building technology into nearly every part of our recruiting operation.



Interested in growth.

We want someone who wants to eventually take on more responsibility rather than remain an administrative assistant forever.



Schedule



We expect to begin at approximately 20 hours per week.



Because you will interview U.S.-based candidates and communicate with our management team, you must be available for regular working hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



For the right person, this position can grow into a full-time role with increasing responsibility.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience.



We are willing to pay more for someone who has real recruiting experience and can independently manage applicants and conduct professional interviews.



We are not looking for the cheapest applicant.



We are looking for the right long-term person.



How to Apply



Please send the following:

title: Legal Research Analyst
description:
Engagement type: Freelance, project-based, remote Duration: Pilot project (3 states), then ongoing per-state engagements through completion of all US jurisdictions.



About Cairnul

Cairnul is agentic fundraising compliance infrastructure that runs a startup's early rounds end to end: SAFEs, advisor agreements, federal and state filings, and the records, deadlines, and governance behind them. We build for first-time founders raising their initial round under Reg D Rule 506(b) or 506(c).



At the core of the product is a compliance library: researched, cited, state-by-state entries covering the securities and corporate law requirements a startup triggers when it raises. Our agents draft only from library entries that outside counsel has verified. If an entry is unverified or stale, the agent declines to draft. That constraint is the product. Your work is what makes it possible.



The project

Every state has its own rules for what a company owes when it sells securities to an investor who lives there: notice filings, fees, deadlines, filing methods, renewal requirements. Roughly 46 states enforce a notice filing for Rule 506 offerings, and the details vary widely. Layered on top are corporate law requirements in key states: board authorization, consent formalities, interested-director rules.



We are building a complete, structured, citation-backed library of these requirements. Your job is to research each state from primary sources, capture the findings in Cairnul's standardized entry format, and produce entries clean enough that a reviewing securities attorney can verify them efficiently. You research and document. Counsel verifies. Nothing ships until counsel signs off.



What you'll do

-Research state securities law requirements for Reg D Rule 506(b) and 506(c) offerings from primary sources: state statutes, administrative codes, securities regulator websites, and official filing systems (EFD and state-specific portals)

-Research state corporate law requirements relevant to early-stage fundraising in designated states: board consent formalities, authorization requirements, interested-director provisions

-Capture findings in Cairnul's entry template: every fact tied to a pinpoint citation (statute or rule section) and a retrieval date

-Record the practical mechanics, not just the law: filing method, fee amount, payment method, deadline trigger, renewal cycle, consequences of late filing as stated by the regulator

-Flag ambiguities, conflicts between sources, and questions that require attorney judgment, rather than resolving them yourself

-Note where a state's official guidance contradicts its statute, or where secondary sources disagree; these flags are part of the deliverable, not a failure of it

-Revise entries based on feedback from Cairnul and, later, from reviewing counsel



On AI tools: Using AI research assistants to find sources and accelerate the work is fine and expected. The rule is that every fact in a submitted entry must be verified by you against the primary source it cites. An AI-generated claim is a lead, not a finding.



Deliverables

For each assigned state:

-A completed entry in Cairnul's template (provided), covering all required fields

-A source log: every authority consulted, with URL, citation, and retrieval date

-An open-questions memo: anything ambiguous, conflicting, or judgment-dependent, stated as a question for counsel



An entry is complete when a securities attorney could verify it by checking your citations, without redoing your research.



What we provide

-A v1 entry template and field definitions. This is a first version; part of the pilot is telling us where it breaks against real state material

-Prioritized state list and sequencing

-Direct access to the Founder for scope questions, with fast turnaround



How you'll work

You are the research function, not a contributor to one. That means high ownership and high agency: you set your approach, you own the accuracy of every entry you submit, and your name is effectively on the library. The team is small and obsessive about detail; the product's core promise is that it never drafts from an unverified fact, and your work is where verification starts.



You'll work directly with the Founder, who runs product, and coordinate with our two engineers on how entries map into the product's data structures. You'll also coordinate with a data engineer who builds the pipeline loading your verified entries into the product; your entries are captured in the structured template, so their work is plumbing, not editing your research. Once outside securities counsel is engaged, your entries go to them for verification and you'll field their questions directly. Clear, precise written communication with all of these audiences is part of the job.



Who this is for

Required:



-Demonstrated legal research experience with US statutes and administrative codes: paralegal background, JD or JD candidate, law librarian, or equivalent freelance track record

-Ability to read a blue sky statute and its implementing regulations and extract operative requirements accurately

-Rigorous citation habits; you distinguish between what a statute says, what a regulator's FAQ says, and what a law firm blog says

-Comfort saying "this is unclear" instead of guessing

-Strong written English; entries are read by engineers and attorneys, so plain and precise beats formal



Strongly preferred:

-Prior work with securities law, Reg D, or blue sky filings specifically

-Familiarity with the EFD system and state securities regulator websites



Not required:

-A license to practice law. This role does not provide legal advice or legal conclusions. You compile, cite, and flag.



What this role is not

-Not web scraping or data engineering. The work is reading and structured capture, done by a person, because accuracy is the point.

-Not legal advice. You do not interpret close calls; you surface them for counsel.

-Not content writing. Entries are structured records, not articles.



Scope and structure

Pilot: Three states assigned at the start, at full per-state rate. The pilot establishes format fit, accuracy, and pace, and it stress-tests the v1 entry template: we expect you to propose field changes where the template doesn't fit what states actually publish. 



Continuation is at Cairnul's discretion based on pilot quality.



Ongoing: Remaining states assigned in batches, sequenced by Cairnul's priority list. Estimated total scope: 40 to 50 state entries. You control your schedule within agreed per-batch deadlines.



Terms: Work for hire; all research product is assigned to Cairnul, Inc. A confidentiality agreement covers the engagement. Payment per completed, accepted entry.



How to apply

Send the following:

-A short note on your relevant research background (no cover letter formalities)

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO



Remote | Flexible Schedule | Long-Term Opportunity



About the Role:



I am looking for a VERY GOOD Executive Assistant who can become my true right hand.



I am a fast-moving entrepreneur managing multiple businesses, projects, clients, team members, and a very busy personal life. I need someone who is proactive, organized, resourceful, dependable, quick-thinking, and able to handle things without needing constant direction.



This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant position where you wait for a list of tasks every morning.



I need someone who can look at a situation, figure out what needs to happen, and handle it.



If you are the type of person who says, “Got it. I’ll take care of it,” this may be the role for you.



What You’ll Do:



Executive & Business Support



* Manage and organize my calendar

* Schedule and reschedule meetings and appointments

* Make and receive business calls when needed

* Follow up with clients, vendors, partners, and team members

* Send reminders and make sure important deadlines are not missed

* Track outstanding tasks and follow-ups

* Conduct online research and provide quick, organized answers

* Help coordinate projects and team activities

* Organize documents, files, and information

* Handle miscellaneous business tasks as they come up

* Assist with customer, vendor, and partner communication

* Help keep me organized and focused on high-value priorities



Personal Support



* Schedule personal appointments

* Make personal calls

* Coordinate reservations and appointments

* Assist with travel planning

* Research and handle personal requests

* Help organize personal schedules and important dates

* Handle miscellaneous personal tasks when needed



The Big Picture



Your job is to make my life easier.



I should be able to say:



“I need this handled.”



And you should be able to figure out the next steps and get it done.



I don’t want to micromanage you. I want to trust you.



Schedule & Availability



Availability Window: Monday–Sunday, 8:00 AM–8:00 PM EST



This does NOT mean you will work 12 hours every day.



Your actual workload will vary depending on my needs.



Some days may require only a couple of hours. Other days may require significantly more. The schedule is flexible, but you must be available and responsive within the designated window when support is needed.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys a dynamic environment where no two days are exactly the same.



Compensation



Starting Compensation: $150 USD per week



This is a fixed weekly contractor retainer, not an hourly position.



You will NOT be paid based on how many minutes a particular task takes.



I care about:



* Getting the job done correctly

* Being responsive

* Being efficient

* Taking initiative

* Following through

* Solving problems

* Anticipating needs

* Being dependable



Exceptional performance and increased responsibility can lead to increased compensation over time.



What I’m Looking For



You should be:



* Extremely organized

* Proactive rather than reactive

* Fast and efficient

* Excellent at communication

* Comfortable making phone calls

* Comfortable communicating with Americans

* A strong problem solver

* Tech-savvy

* Detail-oriented

* Dependable

* Discreet and trustworthy

* Comfortable handling confidential information

* Able to multitask

* Able to prioritize competing requests

* Comfortable with changing priorities

* Able to work independently

* Someone who takes ownership instead of constantly asking what to do next



Most importantly:



You need to have urgency.



I move quickly.



Things change quickly.



Opportunities come up quickly.



I need someone who can move with me.



If something takes 20 minutes to complete, I don’t want it stretched into two hours just to fill time.



I value results and efficiency, not clock-watching.



Technology



You should be comfortable learning and working with tools such as:



* Google Workspace

* Google Calendar

* Slack

* Zoom

* Canva

* Microsoft Office

* Online scheduling tools

* CRM and business platforms

* AI tools such as ChatGPT

* Task/project management systems



You do not need to know every platform listed above, but you must be comfortable learning new technology quickly.



This Role Is NOT For You If…



* You need to be told what to do every step of the way

* You prefer predictable, repetitive work

* You are uncomfortable making phone calls

* You frequently miss deadlines

* You need constant supervision

* You stretch simple tasks to fill hours

* You disappear during agreed availability times

* You struggle with changing priorities

* You don’t take ownership of mistakes

* You are looking for a basic data-entry VA position



This Role IS For You If…



You naturally think:



“Let me figure this out.”



You see a problem and start looking for the solution.



You remember things your boss forgot.



You follow up without being asked.



You notice conflicts on the calendar before they become problems.



You can handle a random request without falling apart.



You protect confidential information.



You are dependable when things get busy.



And you genuinely enjoy being the person behind the scenes who keeps everything moving.



Application Instructions



Send me a voice audio answering these questions…



1. Tell me about your previous Executive Assistant experience.



2. What makes you different from a typical virtual assistant?



3. Give me an example of a time you noticed something needed to be done and handled it without being asked.



4. Include the words “RIGHT HAND” somewhere in your application so I know you read the entire post.







Hiring Process



The hiring process may include:



1. Application review

2. Video interview

3. Practical trial assignment

4. Reference/background verification

5. Paid trial period

6. Long-term placement



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with me long-term, not someone looking for a short-term gig.



If you are highly organized, proactive, intelligent, resourceful, trustworthy, and ready to become the person I can truly depend on, I want to hear from you.



Apply with “RIGHT HAND” in your application.

title: STR Guest Experience & Listing Optimization Specialist
description:
Host with Wander is seeking an experienced short-term rental professional to manage guest communication and actively improve the performance of our luxury vacation-rental listings.



This is not simply a listing-creation or data-entry position. We need someone who understands how to optimize listings to increase search visibility, clicks, conversion, occupancy, and bookings.



Schedule



* 45 hours per week

* Five working days with two consecutive days off

* Some Weekend and Holiday coverage may be required

* The final schedule will be discussed with the selected candidate

* Must be fully available and dedicated to Host with Wander during scheduled hours



Primary Responsibilities



* Manage guest communication with warmth, professionalism, and urgency

* Resolve guest concerns and coordinate with cleaners and maintenance personnel

* Optimize listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, and our direct-booking website

* Improve listing titles, descriptions, amenities, photo order, captions, and positioning

* Research competing properties and identify opportunities for our listings to stand out

* Monitor listing performance and recommend measurable improvements

* Maintain accurate property information across Guesty and all booking channels

* Help launch and optimize new property listings

* Use ChatGPT and other approved tools to analyze performance and improve efficiency



Required Experience



* Hands-on short-term rental guest-communication experience

* Strong knowledge of Airbnb listing optimization

* Experience improving listings—not simply creating or uploading them

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong customer service and problem-solving abilities

* Ability to work independently and follow issues through completion

* Ability to review performance data and recommend improvements

* Willingness to learn and responsibly use AI tools



Experience using Guesty is a plus but is not required.



Complementary Specialty



In addition to guest communication and listing optimization, we would prefer someone with meaningful experience in at least **one** of the following areas:



Bookkeeping



* Organizing income and expense information

* Reviewing transactions and financial records

* Assisting with reconciliations or property-level reporting

* Experience with QuickBooks is a plus



Rankbreeze and Listing Analytics



* Tracking Airbnb search rankings

* Monitoring listing performance

* Conducting competitor research

* Using data to recommend and test listing improvements



Canva and Marketing Support



* Creating professional social media graphics

* Designing property guides, signs, or marketing materials

* Following an established brand style

* Editing templates and preparing polished visual content



Candidates do not need experience in all three areas. Please tell us which area is your strongest and provide specific examples of your work.



Team and Culture Expectations



Host with Wander is building a supportive and collaborative team. We want people who help one another, communicate openly, share information, and work together to solve problems.



The right candidate must:



* Be a genuine team player

* Communicate respectfully and professionally

* Be willing to assist teammates when support is needed

* Share important information rather than working in isolation

* Accept feedback positively and offer feedback constructively

* Take ownership and focus on solutions when problems occur

* Contribute to a culture where everyone works toward shared goals

* Care deeply about providing an excellent experience for every guest



Individual performance matters, but so does the success of the entire team.



Important



We are not looking for someone who has only uploaded or created Airbnb listings. You should understand what helps a listing rank and convert—and be able to explain how your previous work improved performance.



How to Apply



Begin your application with the words **“Top Listing.”**



Please include:



1. How many short-term rental properties you have supported.

2. Which property management systems and booking platforms you have used.

3. A specific listing you optimized, what you changed, and why.

4. Any measurable before-and-after results, such as ranking, conversion, occupancy, bookings, or revenue.

5. An example of a difficult guest situation you handled.

6. An example of how you supported or collaborated with a teammate.

7. Which complementary specialty is your strongest: bookkeeping, Rankbreeze/listing analytics, or Canva.

8. Specific examples of your work in that specialty.

9. How you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools.

10. Confirmation that you can work 45 hours per week, including required weekend coverage.

11. Your requested hourly rate.



Please attach or link to listings you personally optimized. If Canva is your specialty, include a portfolio or work samples. If bookkeeping or Rankbreeze is your specialty,  the tasks you personally handled and the results you achieved.
